title: Enabling AWS Cloud FPGA Development Using High-Level Vitis HLS
title_zh: 利用高级 Vitis HLS 实现 AWS 云 FPGA 开发

paragraphs.en: We present a toolchain for development of ML models on AWS EC2 F2 cloud FPGA infrastructure from high-level language, implementing a complete Vitis HLS → \to HDK bridge → \to AFI workflow that has been absent from the academic literature despite eight years of AWS FPGA availability. We introduce a four-level methodology (FP32 PyTorch → \to bit-accurate quantized Python → \to HLS C-simulation → \to physical FPGA) to aid in localizing errors, including FPGA-specific circuit errors. Together these tools allow coding agents to effectively implement FPGA designs from user directions, testing and debugging as needed. We document the deployment workflow, timing closure strategies, and practical HLS engineering decisions that proved crucial. We validate using TinyBERT fine-tuned for address Named Entity Recognition, implementing the embedding layer and the first of four encoder layers on the FPGA hardware. Our implementation streams weights from host DRAM, yielding poor performance compared to CPU/GPU implementations; we discuss forward paths.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一套在 AWS EC2 F2 云 FPGA 基础设施上从高级语言开发机器学习模型的工具链，实现了完整的 Vitis HLS → HDK 桥接 → AFI 工作流程；尽管 AWS FPGA 已推出八年，这一流程在学术文献中一直缺失。 我们引入了一套四级方法论（FP32 PyTorch → 位精确量化 Python → HLS C 仿真 → 物理 FPGA），用于帮助定位错误，包括 FPGA 特有的电路错误。 这些工具相结合，使智能体能够根据用户指令有效地实现 FPGA 设计，并按需进行测试与调试。 我们记录了部署工作流程、时序收敛策略以及被证明至关重要的实用 HLS 工程决策。 我们使用针对命名实体识别任务微调的 TinyBERT 进行验证，在 FPGA 硬件上实现了嵌入层和四个编码器层中的第一层。 我们的实现从主机 DRAM 流式读取权重，导致性能相比 CPU/GPU 实现较差；我们讨论了未来的改进路径。

paragraphs.en: Engineering demanding workloads such as ML inference requires coordinated optimization between the hardware architecture and software operations. The transformer-based software stack that represents current state of the art in ML implements a neural network via matrix multiplication operations. These operations are accelerated by high-performance hardware GPUs with on-board memory. Transformer inference is increasingly constrained by memory bandwidth rather than compute [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 工程化诸如机器学习推理这类高负载工作，需要在硬件架构与软件操作之间进行协同优化。 代表当前机器学习最先进水平的基于 Transformer 的软件栈，通过矩阵乘法运算来实现神经网络。 这些运算由配备片上存储器的高性能硬件 GPU 来加速。 Transformer 推理日益受到内存带宽而非算力的制约 [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In comparison with the essentially von Neumann-based CPU/GPU architecture, Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) devices represent an alternative hardware platform. FPGAs offer memory distributed throughout the device and feature programmable circuitry, allowing memory and compute to be placed together in a more distributed way. These features support deterministic latency and fixed power draw independent of request rate, and could permit more efficient designs, particularly for implementing smaller models and those where GPU tail-latency variance and idle power are concerns [ 5 , 6 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 与本质上基于冯·诺依曼架构的 CPU/GPU 架构相比，现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）设备代表了一种替代性的硬件平台。 FPGA 在整个器件中分布着存储器，并具有可编程电路的特性，使存储和计算能够以更分布式的方式放置在一起。 这些特性支持确定性的延迟和与请求速率无关的固定功耗，并可能实现更高效的设计，特别是对于部署较小的模型以及那些 GPU 尾延迟波动和空闲功耗令人担忧的场景 [ 5 , 6 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Research in generative AI using FPGA devices has been constrained, however, by the difficulty of programming ML systems on them. Despite eight years of availability (F1 since 2017, F2 since December 2024 [ 7 ] ), AWS cloud FPGA instances have not been used for ML inference in any published academic work, although their pay-on-demand cost model lowers the funding barrier for research projects. The University of Toronto noted in 2024 that F1 instances “have not been used for such large ML applications” [ 8 ] . The gap is not hardware capability; the AMD VU47P on F2 has 9,024 DSP slices, 16 GiB HBM, and 64 GiB DDR4. We identify the absence of a documented, reproducible workflow from HLS C++ kernels to deployed Amazon FPGA Images (AFIs) as the barrier.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，使用 FPGA 器件进行生成式 AI 研究一直受到制约，原因在于在其上编程 ML 系统十分困难。 尽管 AWS 云 FPGA 实例已经可用八年之久（F1 自 2017 年起，F2 自 2024 年 12 月起 [ 7 ] ），但在任何已发表的学术工作中都没有将其用于 ML 推理，尽管其按需付费的成本模式降低了研究项目的资金门槛。 多伦多大学在 2024 年指出，F1 实例“尚未被用于此类大型 ML 应用” [ 8 ] 。 这一差距并非源于硬件能力；F2 上的 AMD VU47P 拥有 9,024 个 DSP 切片、16 GiB HBM 和 64 GiB DDR4。 我们认为，从 HLS C++ 内核到已部署的 Amazon FPGA 镜像（AFI）缺乏有文档记录且可复现的工作流程，才是真正的障碍。

paragraphs.en: While FPGAs provide programmable hardware, the physical architecture of the device remains important for combined hardware/software optimization. The AWS F2 instance hosts an AMD VU47P Virtex UltraScale+ FPGA which is organized in three separate dies called Super-Logic Regions (SLRs), which are co-located and wired together (see Figure 1 ). Crossing an SLR boundary requires traversing a long wire, which may cause signal timing problems.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 FPGA 提供了可编程硬件，但器件的物理架构对于软硬件联合优化仍然十分重要。 AWS F2 实例搭载了一颗 AMD VU47P Virtex UltraScale+ FPGA，该 FPGA 由三个称为 Super-Logic Region（SLR）的独立裸片组成，这些裸片并列放置并通过连线互连（见图 1）。 跨越 SLR 边界需要经过一根很长的连线，这可能引发信号时序问题。

paragraphs.en: Memory in an FPGA is distributed throughout SLRs and is available in a hierarchy of layers that are progressively both larger and farther away from individual logic elements, as shown in Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: FPGA 中的存储器分布在各个 SLR 中，并以分层结构提供，各层级规模逐渐增大，且距离单个逻辑元件越来越远，如表 1 所示。

paragraphs.en: FPGA devices are natively programmed in a low-level Hardware Description Language (HDL), the most popular being Verilog/SystemVerilog and VHDL. When fed into a synthesis tool ("Vivado" on the AMD/Xilinx FPGAs that the AWS F2 uses) the HDL code produces a physical design that specifies the direct placement of logic cells, lookup tables (LUTs), and routing, to which the FPGA is then configured. This level of implementation is termed Register-Transfer Level (RTL) logic. While conceptually comparable to an assembler producing machine code, the physical design is literally a circuit design which the FPGA directly manifests via a grid (array) of programmable logic gates, as compared with the set of CPU instructions that machine code represents. The physical design can thus, for example, specify many paths that execute in parallel by physically manifesting different circuit paths. The Vivado synthesis tool performs more sophisticated operations than an assembler, making use of simulation to optimize the timing and physical placement of the circuit design.
paragraphs.zh: FPGA 器件通常使用底层硬件描述语言（HDL）进行编程，最常用的是 Verilog/SystemVerilog 和 VHDL。 将 HDL 代码输入综合工具（AWS F2 所使用的 AMD/Xilinx FPGA 上的“Vivado”）后，会生成一个物理设计，其中指定了逻辑单元、查找表（LUT）和布线的直接放置位置，FPGA 随后被配置为该设计。 这种实现层次被称为寄存器传输级（RTL）逻辑。 虽然在概念上类似于汇编器生成机器码，但物理设计实际上是一个电路设计，FPGA 通过可编程逻辑门构成的网格（阵列）直接将其呈现出来，这与机器码所代表的一组 CPU 指令形成对比。 因此，物理设计可以通过物理呈现不同的电路路径，指定许多并行执行的路径。 Vivado 综合工具比汇编器执行更复杂的操作，利用仿真来优化电路设计的时序和物理布局。

paragraphs.en: The Hardware Development Kit (HDK) for the AWS F2 [ 9 ] provides a shell that separates AWS-managed infrastructure (PCIe, DDR controllers, DMA) from user custom logic (CL). The shell handles infrastructure functions and provides defined interface points to which the user-supplied CL integrates. Unlike the user/kernel separation in a traditional OS, the shell and user CL are combined by the Vivado synthesizer to produce the RTL/circuit design, so both shell and user CL ultimately directly manifest hardware. Conceptually the shell is more similar to the set of linked libraries that operate the loop and pseudo-OS functions in a Real-Time Development Kit (RTK).
paragraphs.zh: 适用于 AWS F2 [ 9 ] 的硬件开发套件（HDK）提供了一个外壳（shell），将 AWS 管理的基础设施（PCIe、DDR 控制器、DMA）与用户自定义逻辑（CL）分离。 外壳负责基础设施功能，并提供定义好的接口点，用户提供的自定义逻辑（CL）集成到这些接口点上。 与传统操作系统中的用户/内核分离不同，外壳和用户自定义逻辑由 Vivado 综合器组合以生成 RTL/电路设计，因此外壳和用户自定义逻辑最终都直接体现为硬件。 从概念上讲，外壳更类似于在实时开发套件（RTK）中操作循环和伪操作系统功能的链接库集合。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows the system architecture. The host loads tokenized input and packed W16A16 weights into DDR4 via PCIe. The CL kernel processes the four-layer TinyBERT pipeline through a single m_axi DDR port: each stage reads its weight matrix and input activations, computes, and writes output activations back to DDR at fixed offsets. This sequential DDR round-trip is the primary latency bottleneck in the current design.
paragraphs.zh: 图3展示了系统架构。 主机通过 PCIe 将分词后的输入和打包的 W16A16 权重加载到 DDR4 中。 CL 内核通过单个 m_axi DDR 端口处理四层 TinyBERT 流水线：每个阶段读取其权重矩阵和输入激活，进行计算，并将输出激活写回 DDR 的固定偏移位置。 这种顺序的 DDR 往返访问是当前设计中主要的延迟瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: We originally stored the weights in BRAM. Our first design resulted in a deep LUT mux tree that could not close 250 MHz timing. A redesign partitioned weights in BRAM into banks, but the transformer matmul (a fundamentally global operation) created cross-SLR routing congestion that also could not close timing. HBM would have been ideal for this case, but since the bridge can not address it (Section 2.3 ), we needed to store weights in DRAM. Still, BRAM working storage spanned two of the three SLRs (SLR0 53.5%, SLR1 46.9%, with SLR2 at 3.9% holding only the shell’s DDR controller), forcing the working footprint across an SLR boundary and continually causing timing violations. The issue was finally resolved by moving the largest ∼ {\sim} 600k array to URAM, clearing timing (WNS = +0.027ns).
paragraphs.zh: 我们最初将权重存储在 BRAM 中。 我们的第一版设计产生了一个深层的 LUT 多路选择树，无法收敛 250 MHz 的时序。 重新设计后将 BRAM 中的权重划分为多个存储体，但 transformer 的矩阵乘法（一种本质上全局的操作）产生了跨 SLR 的布线拥塞，同样无法收敛时序。 HMB 本来是这种情况的理想选择，但由于桥接器无法对其进行寻址（第 2.3 节），我们需要将权重存储在 DRAM 中。 尽管如此，BRAM 工作存储仍跨越了三个 SLR 中的两个（SLR0 占 53.5%，SLR1 占 46.9%，SLR2 仅占 3.9%，只容纳外壳的 DDR 控制器），迫使工作足迹跨越 SLR 边界，并持续导致时序违例。 该问题最终通过将最大的约 60 万大小的数组移至 URAM 而得到解决，时序收敛（WNS = +0.027ns）。

paragraphs.en: We began with W8A8 (INT8 weights and activations with per-channel/per-token dynamic scaling). Two problems emerged. First, INT8 per-token quantization produces large intermediate errors (maximum 86.0 at the FFN stage for a known outlier activation of ∼ 4528 {\sim}4528 in FP32). While these errors often cancel at the argmax level, they make layer-by-layer FPGA verification intractable: when each stage must be numerically compared against the reference, errors of this magnitude obscure the distinction between quantization noise and implementation bugs. Second, W8A8 generated timing violations on the FPGA: the per-token quantization division produced a hardware divider that failed timing ( WNS = − 1.148 \text{WNS}=-1.148 ns), and FP32 intermediate operations could not meet the 250 MHz clock constraint. W16A16 resolves both issues: the division is replaced by a reciprocal multiply (Section 2.6 ) and maximum intermediate error drops to ≤ 0.137 {\leq}\,0.137 across all encoder stages, enabling the four-level validation methodology (Section 2.8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 W8A8（INT8 权重与激活值，采用逐通道/逐词元动态缩放）开始。随后出现了两个问题。 首先，INT8 逐词元量化会产生较大的中间误差（对于 FP32 中约 4528 的已知离群激活值，在 FFN 阶段的最大误差达到 86.0）。 虽然这些误差在 argmax 层面常常相互抵消，但它们使得逐层的 FPGA 验证难以进行：当每个阶段都必须与参考结果进行数值比较时，这种量级的误差会掩盖量化噪声与实现缺陷之间的区别。 其次，W8A8 在 FPGA 上产生了时序违例：逐词元量化中的除法生成了无法满足时序要求的硬件除法器（WNS = -1.148 ns），且 FP32 中间运算无法满足 250 MHz 的时钟约束。 W16A16 同时解决了这两个问题：除法被替换为倒数乘法（见 2.6 节），并且所有编码器阶段的最大中间误差降至 ≤ 0.137，从而支持了四级验证方法（见 2.8 节）。

paragraphs.en: Better quantization schemes for optimizing memory and model size are available, particularly those described in [ 15 ] . However, FPGA development is, at its core, electrical engineering, not computer programming. As such, it imposes significant and fundamental differences on error analysis. In traditional CPU/GPU-based programming, mathematical operations themselves can be assumed to work. This is not the case in FPGA design synthesis, where these operations represent circuits that can be malformed, or can use IP cores that do not work properly in the accuracy range requested. Using W16A16 with generous accumulators, while not optimal for efficiency, allowed sufficient headroom to identify when errors were being introduced so they could be localized using the four-level validation method described in § 2.8 .

paragraphs.en: Our initial implementation used hls_math.h vendor functions throughout. In practice, we found that hls::exp() on ap_fixed<32,16> returns zero on physical FPGA after place-and-route (an apparent bug in the HLS-generated RTL core); hls::erf() promotes to FP64, generating dmul_64 / dadd_64 IP cores that violate 250 MHz timing; and 64-bit fixed-point division generates an sdiv_80ns_48ns_80 hardware divider (WNS = − 1.148 =-1.148 ns). We replaced each with a targeted alternative: (1) softmax exp uses a 2048-entry LUT covering [ − 11 , 0 ] [-11,0] ; (2) GELU uses a 4096-entry LUT with linear interpolation covering [ − 8 , 8 ] [-8,8] (max error < 3 × 10 − 5 <3\times 10^{-5} vs. FP64, 30 × \times better than a tanh approximation); (3) activation quantization division uses a float32 reciprocal ( inv_am = 1.0f / (float)am ) followed by per-element multiply. A fourth issue, dequantization overflow for large accumulator products (e.g., FFN dim 3 outlier: ∼ \sim 69B, overflowing ap_fixed<64,32> ’s ± \pm 2.1B range), was resolved by widening steps 1–2 of the four-step dequantization to ap_fixed<80,48> before truncating. As a timing closure technique, the GELU output array ( 128 × 1200 = 600 128\times 1200=600 KB BRAM) was eliminated by computing GELU twice (once for absmax, once for quantization), avoiding an SLR-crossing BRAM placement that added 2.3 ns logic + 2.7 ns routing. Fuketa et al. [ 16 ] take a contrasting approach, replacing all transcendentals with polynomial matrix approximations; our hybrid LUT strategy prioritizes accuracy (vendor-optimized or validated LUT) while avoiding the timing hazards of large IP cores.

paragraphs.en: We validate correctness through four implementation levels (Figure 4 ). The L2 intermediate is the key contribution: a Python reference that replicates HLS ap_fixed arithmetic exactly, enabling per-stage error isolation without FPGA builds. When L3 or L4 output diverges from L1, L2 isolates whether the cause is quantization design (L1 vs L2 mismatch) or implementation error (L2 vs L3/L4 mismatch). For example, when implementing the first TinyBERT layer we observed incorrect results in L4, while L3 was correct: the logic and code were correct, but there was an error specific to the FPGA implementation. Investigation via targeted builds eventually determined that the HLS-to-CL bridge had not copied the .dat initialization file into the synthesis directory. Vivado silently zero-filled the ROM, so on hardware the LUT returned zero for every input. The 4-level validation serves as an effective loop closure tool, allowing the coding agent to autonomously localize and diagnose problems.

paragraphs.en: We conducted the work during a 1-month research spike, which included initial paper writeup. The team consisted of a single human researcher using an AWS Kiro IDE coding agent (responsible for FPGA programming and investigation) and an Amazon Quick desktop AI (responsible for higher level strategic inquiry, including literature searches, and also LaTeX formatting). paragraphs.en: Achieving timing closure on the AMD VU47P (3-SLR SSI device) for an ML workload required 21+ DCP builds across two stages. Stage 1 (embedding layer) converged from − 1.533 -1.533 ns to − 0.050 -0.050 ns over 10 builds; Stage 2 (encoder layer 0) converged from − 1.533 -1.533 ns to + 0.001 +0.001 ns over 16 builds. The Worst Negative Slack (WNS) convergence follows a logarithmic decay with non-monotone excursions from failed experiments (Figure 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 AMD VU47P（3-SLR SSI 器件）上为机器学习负载实现时序收敛，需要在两个阶段中进行超过 21 次 DCP 构建。 阶段 1（嵌入层）经过 10 次构建，从不收敛的 −1.533 ns 收敛到 −0.050 ns；阶段 2（编码器第 0 层）经过 16 次构建，从 −1.533 ns 收敛到 +0.001 ns。 最差负时序裕量（WNS）的收敛过程呈现对数衰减趋势，并因失败的实验而出现非单调的波动（图 5）。

paragraphs.en: Because the FPGA build was complete only for the embedding layer and encoder layer 0, we measured that portion across FPGA, CPU, and GPU, using identical inputs. For a short 16-token input (representative of NER), the FPGA is ∼ 480 × {\sim}480\times slower than CPU and ∼ 410 × {\sim}410\times slower than GPU (Table 4 ), almost completely due to the latency of fetching weights from host DRAM.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 FPGA 构建仅完成了嵌入层和编码器第 0 层，我们在 FPGA、CPU 和 GPU 上使用相同输入对这部分进行了测量。 对于较短的 16 个词元的输入（可代表 NER 任务），FPGA 比 CPU 慢约 {\sim}480 倍，比 GPU 慢约 {\sim}410 倍（表 4），这几乎完全是由于从主机 DRAM 获取权重的延迟所致。

paragraphs.en: Debug writes dominate routing pressure. Removing the GELU output debug dump alone improved WNS by 0.37 ns (v2_enc0g). Debug writes add DDR write calls that increase routing congestion and can place small arrays across SLR boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 调试写入主导了布线压力。 仅移除 GELU 输出调试转储一项，就将 WNS 改善了 0.37 ns（v2_enc0g）。 调试写入会增加 DDR 写调用，从而加剧布线拥塞，并可能使小型阵列跨越 SLR 边界分布。

paragraphs.en: BRAM latency pragmas are non-monotone. latency=2 on input_i16 (78 KB INT16 activation buffer) improved WNS from − 0.534 -0.534 ns to − 0.343 -0.343 ns. Applying latency=2 to all large arrays (Q/K/V/attn_out) worsened WNS from − 0.343 -0.343 ns to − 0.649 -0.649 ns as Vivado placed the BRAMs further apart under tighter scheduling constraints. The sweet spot is selective application to the specific array on the critical path.
paragraphs.zh: BRAM 延迟 pragma 的效果是非单调的。对 input_i16（78 KB 的 INT16 激活缓冲区）设置 latency=2 后，WNS 从 −0.534 ns 改善到 −0.343 ns。 将 latency=2 应用于所有大数组（Q/K/V/attn_out）反而使 WNS 从 −0.343 ns 恶化到 −0.649 ns，因为在更紧的调度约束下，Vivado 将这些 BRAM 布置得更远。 最佳做法是选择性地只对位于关键路径上的特定数组应用该 pragma。

paragraphs.en: The toolchain described in § 2.2 effectively enables writing high-level code in Vitis HLS and deploying it to a cloud-based F2 instance.
paragraphs.zh: §2.2 中描述的工具链有效地支持了在 Vitis HLS 中编写高级代码，并将其部署到基于云的 F2 实例。

paragraphs.en: The 4-level validation process is effective at identifying FPGA-specific problem areas such as broken IP cores and logic manifestation defects, and with sufficient continued effort would facilitate building out the remaining layers.
paragraphs.zh: 四级验证流程能够有效识别 FPGA 特有的问题领域，例如损坏的 IP 核和逻辑显现缺陷，并且只要持续投入足够的努力，将有助于构建其余的层。

paragraphs.en: Performance of our reference TinyBERT implementation is poor vs. a standard GPU implementation, although we expect it could be improved considerably by moving to more standard INT8 quantization now that the toolchain is established and design patterns identified.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的参考 TinyBERT 实现的性能相比标准 GPU 实现较差，不过我们预计，既然工具链已经建立、设计模式也已明确，通过转向更标准的 INT8 量化，其性能可以得到显著提升。

paragraphs.en: Moving weights from DRAM onto the FPGA dominated latency, a cost made worse by the bridge’s single DDR port and lack of HBM access (Section 2.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 将权重从 DRAM 搬运到 FPGA 上占据了主要延迟，而桥接器的单 DDR 端口以及缺乏 HBM 访问能力使这一开销进一步恶化（第 2.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Transformers are architecturally optimized for large tensor operations that perform well on GPU hardware acceleration - fundamentally a von Neumann approach. A naive transformer implementation does not fit optimally to the FPGA’s multi-layer distributed memory architecture.
paragraphs.zh: Transformer 在架构上针对大型张量运算进行了优化，这类运算在 GPU 硬件加速上表现良好——本质上是一种冯·诺依曼方法。 朴素的 Transformer 实现并不能最优地适配 FPGA 的多层分布式内存架构。

paragraphs.en: Given the above results, pursuing higher performance solutions must contemplate either augmenting or abandoning the bridge, and should consider non-transformer architectures for which distributed memory local to compute elements is more advantageous.
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于上述结果，追求更高性能的解决方案必须考虑增强或放弃该桥接结构，并应考虑采用非 Transformer 架构，因为此类架构中计算单元本地的分布式内存更具优势。

paragraphs.en: Although we have established a toolchain that allows development of a FPGA design from a high level language (Vitis HLS) to a deployable AFI, this path comes at the cost of greatly limited memory management. One path forward would require enhancing the bridge to support multi-channel DMA access and HBM access. There are no conceptual barriers to doing this. Although it is a large lift, with coding agent assistance, loop engineering principles, and the four-level validation methodology this path appears reachable.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管我们已经建立了一条从高级语言（Vitis HLS）到可部署 AFI 的 FPGA 设计工具链，但这条路径的代价是内存管理受到极大限制。 前进的一条路径需要增强桥接器以支持多通道 DMA 访问和 HBM 访问。 这样做不存在概念上的障碍。 虽然这是一项巨大的工程，但在智能体编码辅助、循环工程原则以及四级验证方法的支持下，这条路径看起来是可以实现的。

paragraphs.en: Another option is to simply abandon the bridge, which also requires abandoning high-level Vitis HLS and instead implement designs in much lower-level HDL code. Here again the increasing sophistication of coding agents at building low-level code like circuit designs may lower the traditionally high barrier of effort.

paragraphs.en: Work is under way on running non-transformer generative architectures such as Mamba [ 18 ] on FPGAs [ 19 ] , but these designs still stream weights from off-chip memory (§ 5.4 ). The FPGA’s highly parallel, distributed-memory fabric is better suited to traditional machine-learning models, which coding agents can now build and deploy with the toolchain we describe. Boosted decision trees compiled to FPGA firmware evaluate in tens of nanoseconds [ 20 , 21 ] , and online tree learning can run on the incoming data stream itself [ 22 ] . Network security is a natural target: traffic is a continuous stream, the market is established, and detection rules must change as attacks evolve. Flow-based intrusion detectors already classify traffic on FPGA SmartNICs at line rate using a few hundred LUTs [ 23 ] , and a coding agent able to regenerate and redeploy such a detector as threats change would make the approach considerably more practical.
paragraphs.zh: 目前已有工作在研究如何在 FPGA 上运行 Mamba [18] 等非 Transformer 生成式架构 [19]，但这些设计仍然需要从片外内存流式读取权重（见 §5.4）。 FPGA 高度并行、分布式内存的结构更适合传统的机器学习模型，而智能体现在可以借助我们描述的工具链来构建并部署这些模型。 编译成 FPGA 固件的提升决策树可以在几十纳秒内完成评估 [20, 21]，而且在线树学习可以直接在输入数据流上运行 [22]。 网络安全是一个天然的目标应用：流量本身是连续的数据流，市场已经成熟，而检测规则必须随攻击手段的演变而不断更新。 基于流的入侵检测器已经在 FPGA 智能网卡（SmartNIC）上仅用几百个 LUT 就能以线速对流量进行分类 [23]，如果智能体能够在威胁变化时重新生成并重新部署这样的检测器，将使这一方法更加实用。

paragraphs.en: The FPGA transformer acceleration literature has grown rapidly since FQ-BERT (2021) [ 24 ] , which first demonstrated fully-quantized BERT-base inference on Xilinx ZCU102. Recent work includes ProTEA [ 25 ] and FAMOUS [ 26 ] (programmable encoder accelerators on Alveo U55C), ADAPTOR [ 27 ] (runtime-adaptive encoder/decoder), BETA [ 28 ] (binary transformers on ZCU102), and HLSTransform [ 29 ] (HLS-based Llama 2 on VU9P). NPE [ 30 ] introduced an overlay processor approach for NLP on FPGA. The two Waterloo 2025 theses [ 31 , 32 ] represent the closest prior work: integer-only BERT on PYNQ-Z1/KV260 for GLUE benchmarks. Other recent contributions include g-BERT [ 33 ] (hardware-aware pruning), Fuketa et al. [ 16 ] (matrix arithmetic-only BERT), BAQET [ 34 ] (BRAM-aware quantization), and AutoTrans [ 35 ] (automated accelerator generation). The hls4ml framework [ 36 ] targets sub-1K parameter models for particle physics applications, a fundamentally different scale from the 14.5M-parameter full transformer addressed here. Table 5 compares these works with ours.
paragraphs.zh: 自 FQ-BERT（2021）[24] 首次在 Xilinx ZCU102 上演示了全量化 BERT-base 推理以来，FPGA transformer 加速领域的文献迅速增长。 近期的工作包括 ProTEA [25] 和 FAMOUS [26]（Alveo U55C 上的可编程编码器加速器）、ADAPTOR [27]（运行时自适应的编码器/解码器）、BETA [28]（ZCU102 上的二值化 transformer）以及 HLSTransform [29]（VU9P 上基于 HLS 的 Llama 2）。 NPE [30] 提出了一种面向 FPGA 上自然语言处理的覆盖层处理器方法。 两篇滑铁卢大学 2025 年的学位论文 [31, 32] 代表了最接近的已有工作：在 PYNQ-Z1/KV260 上实现面向 GLUE 基准的仅整数 BERT。 其他近期贡献包括 g-BERT [33]（硬件感知剪枝）、Fuketa 等人 [16]（仅矩阵运算的 BERT）、BAQET [34]（BRAM 感知量化）以及 AutoTrans [35]（自动化加速器生成）。 hls4ml 框架 [36] 面向的是粒子物理应用中参数量低于 1K 的模型，这与本文所处理的 1450 万参数的完整 transformer 在规模上有着根本的不同。 表 5 将这些工作与我们的工作进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: The FPGA transformer community has generally converged on INT8 or lower to maximize throughput and minimize latency. FQ-BERT uses full quantization, BETA uses binary (1-bit) weights, TerEffic [ 37 ] uses ternary (1.58-bit), FlightLLM [ 6 ] uses INT4/INT8. TATAA [ 38 ] uses mixed INT8 + bfloat16, the closest to higher precision. ITA [ 39 ] demonstrates integer-only softmax at 8-bit. We instead used W16A16 (16-bit fixed-point weights and activations), chosen so that numerical errors introduced by the circuit itself could be separated from quantization noise (Section 2.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: FPGA Transformer 社区普遍已收敛到 INT8 或更低精度，以最大化吞吐量并最小化延迟。 FQ-BERT 采用全量化，BETA 使用二值（1 位）权重，TerEffic [ 37 ] 使用三值（1.58 位），FlightLLM [ 6 ] 使用 INT4/INT8。 TATAA [ 38 ] 使用 INT8 与 bfloat16 的混合精度，是最接近更高精度的方案。 ITA [ 39 ] 展示了 8 位的纯整数 softmax。 我们则采用 W16A16（16 位定点权重与激活值），这样选择是为了能够将电路本身引入的数值误差与量化噪声分离开来（第 2.6 节）。

paragraphs.en: The weight-streaming bottleneck we characterize (§ 2.3 ) follows from the transformer’s reliance on large weight matrices that cannot reside on-chip. Architectures with a bounded working set avoid the growing key-value cache. Mamba [ 18 ] replaces attention with a linear-time selective recurrence and a fixed-size hidden state. LightMamba [ 19 ] , the first FPGA Mamba accelerator, keeps that state on-chip but still streams weights from off-chip memory, and reaches 7.21 tokens/s on a Versal VCK190. HFRWKV [ 42 ] implements the RNN-style RWKV model [ 43 ] fully on-chip for smaller models and reports 32 × \times the throughput of a GPU on Alveo U50 and U280 cards. To our knowledge, no published FPGA design runs a Mamba model with its weights resident on-chip.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在第2.3节中所刻画的权重流式传输瓶颈，源于Transformer对无法完全驻留在片上的大型权重矩阵的依赖。 具有有界工作集的架构避免了不断增长的键值缓存。 Mamba [18] 用线性时间的选择性递归和固定大小的隐藏状态取代了注意力机制。 LightMamba [19] 是首个FPGA Mamba加速器，它将该状态保留在片上，但仍需从片外存储器流式传输权重，并在Versal VCK190上达到7.21 tokens/s。 HFRWKV [42] 为较小的模型将RNN风格的RWKV模型 [43] 完全实现在片上，并在Alveo U50和U280卡上报告了32 × \times 于GPU的吞吐量。 据我们所知，目前尚无已发表的FPGA设计能够运行权重完全驻留在片上的Mamba模型。

sents.en: LightMamba [ 19 ] , the first FPGA Mamba accelerator, keeps that state on-chip but still streams weights from off-chip memory, and reaches 7.21 tokens/s on a Versal VCK190.

sents.en: HFRWKV [ 42 ] implements the RNN-style RWKV model [ 43 ] fully on-chip for smaller models and reports 32 × \times the throughput of a GPU on Alveo U50 and U280 cards.
sents.zh: HFRWKV [42] 为较小的模型将RNN风格的RWKV模型 [43] 完全实现在片上，并在Alveo U50和U280卡上报告了32 × \times 于GPU的吞吐量。

sents.en: To our knowledge, no published FPGA design runs a Mamba model with its weights resident on-chip.
sents.zh: 据我们所知，目前尚无已发表的FPGA设计能够运行权重完全驻留在片上的Mamba模型。

paragraphs.en: We presented a complete toolchain for development of ML models on the AWS EC2 F2 cloud FPGA infrastructure, from high-level Vitis HLS code to the deployable AFI image. We introduced a 4-level validation methodology to localize errors to logic, quantization, HLS code, or FPGA circuit implementation. Together these tools allow coding agents to effectively implement designs on a cloud FPGA, testing and debugging until the design is valid. We documented the practical design issues, including various kinds of defects, and their resolutions. For a validation test we implemented the TinyBERT transformer fine-tuned for Named Entity Recognition on a synthetic address data set, implementing the full transformer in C-sim and the embedding layer and the first of four encoder layers on the FPGA hardware. Performance on the FPGA is poor due to latency streaming weights from host DRAM; we discuss the memory access limitations of the community bridge and the directions of future work, including expanding the bridge or switching to lower level HDL, why transformers are poorly suited to FPGA hardware, and which kinds of ML problems the FPGA can best be applied to, particularly now that the toolchain facilitates agentic FPGA development. We hope this work lowers the barrier to cloud FPGA deployment for ML practitioners and opens the AWS F2 platform to the broader ML research community.
paragraphs.zh: 我们展示了一套完整的工具链，用于在 AWS EC2 F2 云 FPGA 基础设施上开发机器学习模型，涵盖从高层 Vitis HLS 代码到可部署 AFI 镜像的全流程。 我们提出了一种四级验证方法，可将错误定位到逻辑、量化、HLS 代码或 FPGA 电路实现层面。 这些工具结合起来，使智能体能够在云 FPGA 上有效地实现设计，并进行测试和调试，直至设计有效。 我们记录了实际设计中的问题，包括各类缺陷及其解决方法。 作为验证测试，我们在一个合成地址数据集上实现了针对命名实体识别微调的 TinyBERT transformer，在 C 仿真中实现了完整的 transformer，并在 FPGA 硬件上实现了嵌入层和四个编码器层中的第一层。 FPGA 上的性能较差，原因是从主机 DRAM 流式读取权重带来的延迟；我们讨论了社区桥接的内存访问限制以及未来工作的方向，包括扩展桥接或切换到更低层的 HDL、为什么 transformer 不适合 FPGA 硬件，以及哪些类型的机器学习问题最适合应用 FPGA——尤其是在该工具链使得智能体化的 FPGA 开发成为可能的当下。 我们希望这项工作能降低机器学习从业者部署云 FPGA 的门槛，并将 AWS F2 平台向更广泛的机器学习研究社区开放。
